faqs.q: What is the difference between private and sharing houseboat?
faqs.a: A private houseboat is exclusively chartered for your party. A sharing houseboat gives you your own private lockable AC bedroom with en-suite bathroom, while sharing the spacious front deck and dining area with other guests at a fraction of the cost.

faqs.q: Are all meals included in the sharing houseboat?
faqs.a: Yes! Welcome drink, lunch, evening tea with snacks, dinner, and next morning's breakfast are all included and freshly cooked by onboard chefs.

faqs.q: Is it safe for couples and solo travelers?
faqs.a: 100% safe and verified. Each room has an internal lock, and our boats operate under government tourism guidelines with certified crew.

title: Alleppey Shikara Boat Ride
tagline: Glide Through Narrow Village Canals Traditional Style

seo.title: Alleppey Shikara Boat Ride | Narrow Canals & Village Tours
seo.description: Book an authentic Shikara boat ride in Alleppey from ₹800/hr. Explore shallow village canals inaccessible to houseboats. Instant WhatsApp booking.

inclusions: Traditional open-sided wooden boat with shaded canopy and comfortable cushioned seating
Navigates narrow canals, paddy fields, and local villages inaccessible to large houseboats
Expert local boatman guiding you through historic Kuttanad waterways

faqs.q: Why choose a Shikara instead of a houseboat?
faqs.a: Shikaras are nimble and smaller, enabling them to cruise deep into shallow village canals (like Kainakary and Meenappally) where big houseboats cannot enter. It is also much cheaper for day sightseeing trips.

faqs.q: What is the best time for a Shikara ride in Alleppey?
faqs.a: Early morning (6:30 AM - 9:00 AM) for bird watching and calm waters, or late afternoon (4:00 PM - 6:30 PM) for stunning sunset views.

faqs.q: Do I need prior kayaking experience?

faqs.q: What should I wear for kayaking?
